x: July 29th Budapest Invitation 100m: 1.M.Lattany (USA) 10.07 - 5.E.Obeng 10.45; Aug. 7th Crystal Palace AAA Champs. 100m: 1.M.Lattany (USA); 10.24; 2.E.Obeng 10.27; 3.D.McMaster 10.45;
Ernie Obeng sprinted to one of his fastest times (10.28) at Meadowbank aided by a +8.5m wind but found it only good enough for sixth as Mel Lattany ran the first sub 10 sec 100 in Britain.

No finer compliment can be paid to our two than to list a handful of previous winners of these titles. 220yds/200m - Eric Liddell, McDonald Bailey, Steve Riddick, Don Quarrie, Mel Lattany and Stanley Floyd.
